Produce exactly three DIFFERENT structural graph proposals that might satisfy this task: {"envelope_m": [0.09, 0.055], "material": "polypropylene, E=1.4 GPa, yield=35 MPa", "force_n": 4.0, "stroke_min_mm": 2.2, "drift_max_mm": 0.06, "stress_max_mpa": 25.0, "depth_m": 0.01, "min_flexure_thickness_m": 0.0006}. Each graph needs anchors (2-8 [x,y] points), stages (1-4 objects with type=rigid_stage, center=[x,y], height_m expressed as field height), connections (2-16 objects with type=flexure_beam, from_type, from_index, from_port, to_type, to_index, to_port, thickness), and output_stage index. Units are meters. Anchor port is center; stage ports are top/bot/center. Every stage must connect through flexures to ground. Beam length 5-90 mm; thickness >=0.6 mm. Avoid crossing beams. Do not use a topology name as a substitute for graph edges. A graph that does not compile will be rejected without repair.
